items.title: FDA clears AI tool for pediatric bone age assessments
items.excerpt: Bone age assessments are commonly used to evaluate whether a child's skeletal development is consistent with their chronological age.
items.rationale: A dated FDA clearance for a named pediatric radiology task, so it is regulator contact with a direct effect on routine reads.

items.title: Teladoc unveils remote monitoring, ambient AI features
items.excerpt: The company has integrated artificial intelligence scribing and camera-based vitals monitoring into its virtual care platform for hospitals as it works to recover from significant financial setbacks.
items.rationale: A large telehealth vendor is shipping AI scribing and camera-based vitals into its hospital platform, so clinicians will use it in real care and documentation.

items.title: AI-assisted telerehabilitation in early Parkinson’s disease: a multicenter, randomized, multi-arm comparative trial
items.excerpt: This exploratory, multicenter, randomized, rater-blinded, multi-arm comparative trial aimed to evaluate the feasibility and exploratory clinical signals of an AI-facilitated telerehabilitation system across different intervention durations in early-stage Parkinson’s disease (PD). items.rationale: A multicenter, randomized, rater-blinded trial in real early Parkinson's patients. It is a feasibility trial, but it is the only randomized patient read-out in the pool.

items.title: Clairity expands access to AI breast cancer risk tool via Everlywell
items.excerpt: Clairity Breast, FDA De Novo-authorized in 2025, predicts a woman's five-year breast cancer risk from a single screening mammogram; an Everlywell partnership broadens U.S. availability beyond two imaging sites.
items.rationale: An FDA De Novo-authorized risk model is moving from two imaging sites to nationwide patient access. This is new availability for an AI tool patients already use.

items.title: Widespread AI adoption in private practice produces measurable efficiency gains
items.excerpt: European imaging experts recently conducted an expansive study, involving 10 different AI tools from seven separate vendors, implemented across 20 centers staffed by 58 rads.
items.rationale: Real-world deployment evidence from 10 AI tools across 20 centers and 58 radiologists. It measures what adoption changes in practice, not how one model scores on a benchmark.
